svg.title: The Original Maids of Honour, 288 Kew Road
svg.desc: Drawing of the tearoom's frontage: a cream-rendered house under a slate roof, with a long bottle-green fascia lettered in gold, "The Original Maids of Honour", and a raised gable reading "TEAS". Below, an iron cresting rail and a clay-tile canopy lettered "Newens" with a hanging lantern, small-paned shop windows, topiary cones in white planters and white iron chairs on the pavement. The painted sign is on the side wall.
